title: USPER Statement about UAP Sighting
doc_notes: This is a secret FBI document detailing a series of UAP sightings by military personnel during an aerial search mission; encounter content is present.

encounters.summary: Military helicopter crew and intelligence officials observed multiple instances of glowing, oval-shaped orbs that flared in brightness and performed complex maneuvers in close proximity to their aircraft and other military assets.
encounters.entity_appearance: Oval shaped, orange color with white or yellow center, emitting light in all directions.
encounters.entity_behavior: Stationary, flaring in brightness, moving at high speeds, breaking into multiple objects, and pursuing military aircraft.
encounters.entity_count: Multiple, ranging from single orbs to swarms.
encounters.quote: The two orbs appeared to flare up and remain stationary side by side.
